title: Distinguish recoverable undocking from a length-dependent encounter penalty
statement: Bound/undocked tip clocks give P_B=a/[a+w_B+d+u(w_U+d)/(v+w_U+d)] when the unbound exit denominator is nonzero. With v>0 and no fatal hazard, success is1 and mean wait(1+u/v)/a. Independently Gaussian rooted rails give a contact-density penalty proportional toj^-3/2 unless a correctly registered local anchor resets the span.

requires: Two-state B/U continuous-time competing-clock model, success only fromB, stated nonnegative rates and correct returnv. Gaussian contact comparison additionally needs independent ideal rails, a small capture volume and density-to-reaction-rate warrant.
provides: Bound/undocked tip clocks give P_B=a/[a+w_B+d+u(w_U+d)/(v+w_U+d)] when the unbound exit denominator is nonzero. With v>0 and no fatal hazard, success is1 and mean wait(1+u/v)/a. assumptions: Hypothetical rates and numerical long-programme tables are not chemical measurements or an integrated relay. Covalent attachment is not local register or amide-specific completion. Local Gaussian contact is a model, not universal polymer kinetics. Rolling active anchors do not eliminate injury from every retained obsolete handle; multiplying survival factors requires actual independence.
costs: Pay actual complete source/instrument/preparation/chemistry/control contracts and every attempt, failed pulse, wash, report, rejected object, retained handle, settling interval and physical qualification. Exact finite enumeration is exponential where stated. Supplied rates, independence, bounds, structural laws and synthetic model centres are not acquired by fitting or hashing. Equal-information ordinary methods can tie.
contract.units: Rate coefficients need declared concentration normalization; clock hazards in inverse time, exposure in time, hazard ratios/probabilities dimensionless. Contact density is inverse volume and is not itself a chemical rate. Illustrative seconds and programme lengths are model parameters.

body: If v=w_U=d=0, undocking enters a nonreactive closed state and P_B=a/(a+w_B+d+u), not the undefined0/0 continuation. Density-to-rate conversion needs capture-volume/chemical assumptions; existing prepositioned/tethered alternatives already localize partners. Local recapture and positional discrimination remain unmeasured; undocking is not automatically fatal, but correct return is not free.
